errors.text_span: "Level1" occupies approximately 44.32% of the pie, "Level2" comprises approximately 30.04%
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the percentages for Level1 and Level2. The chart shows that Level1 corresponds to 30.04% and Level2 corresponds to 44.32%.

errors.text_span: The segments appear ordered in descending size, from "Level1" to "Level3".
errors.evidence: This statement is false. The slice sizes are not ordered in descending order corresponding to their level number. The largest slice is "Level2" (44.32%), followed by "Level1" (30.04%), and then "Level3" (25.64%).
The description omits the full labels provided on the chart. The actual labels include numerical values: "Level1 - 8.2", "Level2 - 12.1", and "Level3 - 7.0".
